**Built v2 epic action plan (M0-M7) from scans**

What: Epic action plan to finish brain v2, sequencing all 20 open tickets + new un-ticketed scan findings into milestones M0-M7 over feature/v2.0.0. Docs: design-docs/brain-v2-epic-plan.md + docs/inbox/brain-v2-epic-plan.md.
Built from 3 scans: general health, install-distribution, install-self-update.
Scan headlines: no new deep blocker; debt is wiring/doc-integrity + install/update hardening.
- Health: 3-axis shipped in cli.mjs but day-start.mjs hardcodes gentle-ai + personal remote (DR2/DR3, #123 unimplemented); 2 dead resolvers (resolveMemory, resolveHarness); brain-to-engram.mjs zero tests (D4); reviewer verdict defaults /1 vs doctrine /2 (DR1); 4 .env parsers; byte-identical hook compiler.
- Self-update (mortal-risk): NO rollback/atomic-write (U4); plain-copy clobber asymmetry .gemini/CODEOWNERS/AGENTS.md/workflows (U3); corrupt consumer file blocks all upgrades (U6); silent downgrade schemaVersion ratchet (U5); --abort-on-collision opt-in+undocumented (U7); e2e blind to danger paths (U9). #180 clobber fix VERIFIED holding.
- Distribution: private git-tag github-only; first install needs manual package.json edit (no npx init/bin/postinstall); default AGENT_PLATFORM=antigravity vendors .gemini to everyone; brain:adopt is S1-only (S2 --apply/migrate/reconcile dropped, #121 closed prematurely, un-ticketed); Spanish string in bootstrap.sh:226 outside i18n; plain/plainfiles escape hatch works but undiscoverable.
Milestones: M0 housekeeping (#217/#222 close, dup 267 dir, .gitignore chunks); M1 gates G1-G4 (#210,#94,#305); M2 decoupling-reaches-user (#123,DR3,hook dedup,.env unify); M3 reviewer real code-review (#284/#266, inline per-line comments, DR1, gov-status vcs port); M4 dist+update hardening (npx init, registry decision, i18n fix, adopt S2, U3-U9); M5 role-port #312; M6 provider parity (#130,#124,#131,#129); M7 backlog (#268,#280,#263,#256,#247,#117,D4,DR4); terminal cut v2->main.
PENDING DECISION (human): where main cut falls — Shape A (cut after M1, continue on main), Shape B (finish all on v2 then cut), recommended Hybrid (cut after M1+M2). Not yet chosen.
Related: [[architecture/v2-merge-audit]] [[architecture/sdd-role-neutrality]] [[architecture/reviewer-inline-comments]].
